faq_heading: Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs schools: your questions answered

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 11 schools with a Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs street address: 10 public schools and 1 independent school. It also shows 1 college or university campus. In that list, 2 alternate programs and 1 online school.
Public schools here are run by School District 78 (Fraser-Cascade). Count by district: School District 78 (Fraser-Cascade): 10.
Alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address sit under "other public schools and programs"; the level of every school is read from its name.
By mailing community, the Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs list splits as Hope (6), Agassiz (4) and Harrison Hot Springs (1).
Public secondary schools with a Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs address: Agassiz Elem-Secondary and Spirit of Hope Secondary.
Independent schools listed for Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs include Agassiz Christian School.
Before an offer, ask the district which school serves the exact street address.
The Fraser-Cascade school district publishes its catchments only as an interactive map, not as a list of streets. Use the district's own page to check an address:
Fraser-Cascade school district catchments and school finder
These three communities share one school district, so they share this list.

blocks.text: Licensed childcare in Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs

The Ministry's Child Care Map registry lists 16 licensed childcare facilities with a Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs address: 13 licensed group and 3 licensed family. Unlicensed care is not in the registry.

faq.q: How many schools are in Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 11 schools with a Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs street address: 10 public schools and 1 independent school. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.

faq.q: Which school district covers Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs?
faq.a: Public schools with a Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs address are run by School District 78 (Fraser-Cascade).

faq.q: How do I find the catchment school for a Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs address?
faq.a: Ask School District 78 (Fraser-Cascade) to confirm it for the exact street address.
